name: @ai-novel/desktop
author: AI Novel Writing Assistant Team
description: Windows desktop runtime for AI Novel Writing Assistant v2

scripts.dev: pnpm run build && pnpm run start
scripts.pack:dir: pnpm run build && pnpm run prepare:runtime && electron-builder --win dir --x64 --config.npmRebuild=false
scripts.dist: pnpm run build && pnpm run prepare:runtime && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config.npmRebuild=false
